All four House +2FC amount words are explicitly zero. Balance, score, spent, capacity, first Tiberium Value and HouseType IncomeMult are supplied scalar priors.
House +24 uses original vtable 7EA834. Original 4F6990, 4F69D0, 4F9610, 6C9650 and 7C5F00 execute without selected-query or credit substitutions.
The inherited Emu CRT/allocation transport is not entered by this interior. No RNG, timers, detachment, placement or nonempty-storage history is claimed.
Positive Values terminate normally. The sole negative Value is -1 with INT_MAX budget, terminating after one signed SUB wrap. Zero and other potentially nonterminating custom Values are not executed.
